about: Autonomy policy. Read once from this file when the server starts. Workroom requests, intent text and specialist or model output cannot change it.

levels.assist: Explains or suggests. Takes no action.
levels.draft: Writes draft evidence inside the workroom only. No external effect.
levels.execute_within_limits: Runs on its own inside fixed limits. Stops and escalates to people at a limit or on an uncertain result.
levels.execute_with_approval: Runs only after a recorded approval: who, which exact action, when and the limit approved.

explain_changes.description: Show which work is kept, redone or refused after an intent change.

specialist_draft.description: Product, Engineering and Support write draft evidence for the current revision.

specialist_run.description: Start ready specialists for the current revision. Failed work is retried only by an explicit person request.

meta_request.description: Send one scoped request to the Meta API (disabled unless explicitly configured).

publish_artifact.description: Publish the checked local artifact for one revision.
